y-m-35-04.title: Samaynta dhowr dhimman oo xalkoodu yahay −1 < x < 2
y-m-35-04.topic: Go'aaminta isugeynta xalka dhimman laba-jaad leh: u dhexeynta xalka iyo calaamadda isugeynta hore
y-m-35-04.goal: Xalka dhimman laba-jaad leh ka samee dhowr urur oo isugeyn ah oo suurtagal ah, oo sharax sababta isugeynta aan loogu go'aamin mid keliya iyo waxa kale ee loo baahan yahay in la ogaado.
y-m-35-04.material: Ka dhig in xalka dhimman laba-jaad leh ax² + bx + c > 0 (a, b, c waa tirooyin dhan, a ≠ 0) uu yahay −1 < x < 2. Sida loo akhriyo: 'a x labajibaaran iyo b x iyo c way ka weyn yihiin eber. Xalku waa x ka weyn tan taban 1 oo ka yar 2'. Ma aha hal dhimman oo keliya, waxaad rabtaa inaad hesho dhimmanyaasha leh xalkan.

y-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig tibaaxda dhinaca bidix ee doorasho kasta iyo (x + 1)(x − 2), oo hel isku-xirka x ee dhibcaha garaafku taabto muqaalka x.
y-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg jihada calaamadda dhimmanka iyo calaamadda isugeynta hore, oo go'aami in ay tahay fasalka garaafku ka sarreeyo muqaalka x iyo in ay ka hooseyso.
y-m-35-04.s.s1.r.a: Labada xidid −1 iyo 2 waa sax, laakiin garaaf kor u furan, > 0 waa dibadda (x < −1 ama x > 2).
y-m-35-04.s.s1.r.b: Xididdadu waa −2 iyo 1, ma aha −1 iyo 2. Calaamadaha wax-ku-dhufashada iyo wadarta dib ayaa loo akhriyay.
y-m-35-04.s.s1.explain: x² − x − 2 = (x + 1)(x − 2), fasalka tibaaxdan ka yar tahay 0 waa −1 < x < 2. c waa xaaladda tibaaxda calaamadaha ka soo horjeeda ka weyn tahay 0, d waa xaaladda tibaaxda laban-laabantay ka yar tahay 0, e-na waa xaaladda −3 jeer tibaaxda ka weyn tahay 0. a waa x < −1 ama x > 2, b-na waa −2 < x < 1.
y-m-35-04.s.s2.prompt: Samee saddex saddex-lab oo tiro dhan ah (a, b, c), oo leh a kala duwan, oo xalka ax² + bx + c > 0 uu noqdo si sax ah −1 < x < 2.
y-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sidaad ku aragtay doorashooyinka c iyo e, ogow in mid walba uu yahay isla dhimman isugeyntiisa lagu dhuftay lambar qaar. Calaamadda lambarka aad ku dhufanayso ayaa go'aamisa xalka.
y-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ku beddel (a, b, c) aad samaysay ax² + bx + c > 0 oo tijaabi gudaha iyo dibadda fasalka xalka adoo isticmaalaya qiimayaal sida x = 0 iyo x = 3.

y-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Dhibcaha uu taabto muqaalka x ma aha −1 iyo 2. Balaadhi a(x + 1)(x − 2) oo isbarbar dhig isugeynta.

y-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Calaamadahan isugeyn, xalka > 0 ma aha dhexda labada xidid laakiin waa dibadda. Hubi in garaafku kor u furan yahay iyo in hoos u furan yahay.

y-m-35-01.title: |x−2|=2x−7: jawaabaha labada arday way kala duwan yihiin
y-m-35-01.topic: Isla'egyada leh qiime saafi ah: hubinta haddii musharraxiinta xaalad kasta ay ilaaliyaan shuruudda xaaladdaas
y-m-35-01.goal: Isla'ego leh qiime saafi ah, sababo ku xukun kee ka mid ah musharraxiinta lagu helay u kala qaybinta xaalado ay yihiin xal, oo naftaada u naqshadee isla'ego halkaas oo musharrax la tuuro.
y-m-35-01.material:
Laba arday ayaa u xalliyey isla'egta |x − 2| = 2x − 7 (x waa tiro dhab ah). Sida loo akhriyo: '|x − 2| = 2x − 7' waa 'qiimaha saafiga ah ee x laga jaray 2 wuxuu la simanyahay 2x laga jaray 7'. Labada arday labaduba waxay ku bilaabeen u kala qaybinta 'marka x ≥ 2' iyo 'marka x < 2'.
· Marka x ≥ 2: x − 2 = 2x − 7 waxay siisay x = 5.
· Marka x < 2: −(x − 2) = 2x − 7 waxay siisay x = 3.
Ardayga 가 wuxuu jawaabay 'x = 3 ama x = 5', ardayga 나 na wuxuu jawaabay 'x = 5'.

y-m-35-07.title: Haddii discriminant-ku taban yahay, ma had iyo jeer waa togan yahay? Barbar dhigga laba xal
y-m-35-07.topic: Shuruudda is-biyo-ka-weynaanta labajibbaarka ay u run tahay tirooyin dhab ah oo dhan: discriminant-ka iyo calaamadda isku-dhufashada hogaanka
y-m-35-07.goal: Barbar dhig oo qiimee laba xal oo ku saabsan shuruudda odhaah labajibbaar ah ay u togan tahay tirooyin dhab ah oo dhan, ku muuji khaladka hal xal tusaale ka hortag ah, oo qor shuruudda dhammaystiran.
y-m-35-07.material:
k waa joogto dhab ah, dhibaatadana waa 'Hel xadka k ee is-biyo-ka-weynaanta kx² − 4x + k > 0 u run tahay tirooyin dhab ah oo dhan x'. Sida loo akhriyo: 'k x labajibbaar laga jaray 4x ku dar k ka weyn eber'. 
 Xal A: Si garaafku had iyo jeer ugu sarreeyo dhidibka x, waa inaanu la kulmin dhidibka x, sidaas darteed D/4 = 4 − k² < 0, taasi waa, k² > 4. Sidaas darteed k > 2 ama k < −2. 
 Xal B: Ka mid ah k > 2 ama k < −2 ee A laga helay, garaafku waa inuu ku jiraa dhinaca sare, sidaas darteed k > 0 sidoo kale waa loo baahan yahay. Sidaas darteed k > 2.
